Replies stay human (charter rail 4): this only invites replies, it never auto-answers. Text-only (X media optional; designed cards are checker-dead per calendar §media, so text is the correct fallback). Distinct opener from the 08-16 announce and 08-19 feral-bridge X posts; <20% word-overlap with any mood sibling. Campaign story-unique (findPostedDuplicate matches platform+campaign).
